requirements.text: As a user, I want the system to store geographical boundary and location data for each neighborhood, so that the interactive map can display them.
requirements.rationale: An interactive map displaying neighborhood boundaries and locations implies that such spatial data must be stored.

requirements.text: As a user, I want the system to authenticate me before granting access, so that only authorized individuals can explore and compare neighborhood data.
requirements.rationale: The transcript discusses a data-driven application with potentially sensitive housing and amenity data; authentication is a standard security requirement to protect data access, though never explicitly stated.

requirements.text: The application shall provide side-by-side tables and an interactive map without additional charts, graphs, or scoring features.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly declined extra visualizations, indicating a preference for a simple interface.

requirements.text: As a user, I want the system to store housing price data for each neighborhood, so that I can compare costs across neighborhoods.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly stated housing prices as a top priority for comparison.

requirements.text: As a user, I want the system to ensure that housing price and amenities data are accurate, so that my comparisons are reliable.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly stated that data accuracy is important regardless of the source.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to view a list of different neighborhoods so that I can select which ones to explore.
requirements.rationale: Spk 0 explicitly stated this as a user story in c6.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to view detailed housing price data for a selected neighborhood so that I can understand the cost of living.
requirements.rationale: Spk 1 identified housing prices as a top priority, and Spk 0 explicitly captured this as a user story.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to view a detailed list of local amenities for a selected neighborhood so that I can assess the convenience and lifestyle.
requirements.rationale: Spk 1 identified local amenities as a top priority, and Spk 0 explicitly captured this as a user story.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to view housing price and local amenities data in side-by-side tables so that I can compare neighborhoods numerically.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly stated that side-by-side tables are essential for comparing housing prices and amenities.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to use an interactive map to see the geographical locations and boundaries of neighborhoods so that I can understand their layout and proximity.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly requested an interactive map as essential for seeing actual locations.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to select neighborhoods from the interactive map to view or add them to my comparison table so that I can easily initiate comparisons based on location.
requirements.rationale: Spk 0 explicitly stated this as a user story in c6, linking map selection to comparison table.
